analysis.title: Daily Tech Index
key_insights: S&P 500: while 7760 holds as resistance, the desk targets a down-move to 7720, with the 50-day moving average at 7705 in extension. A break above 7760 would target 7785, then 7817.
DAX failed to take out the 50-day moving average at 25,665 on 21 October. While 25,665 is resistance, the desk targets 25,505, then 25,430. A break above targets 25,820, then 25,990.
EuroStoxx50: while 6200 is resistance, the desk targets 6180, then 6145. A break above 6200 would trigger a stronger rebound toward 6240 and 6265.
SMI: while 14,510 is support, the desk targets an up-move to 14,605, then 14,655. A break below 14,510 targets 14,385, then 14,295.
Trend calls: S&P 500 and DAX are down intraday and neutral over 2-5 days. EuroStoxx50 is down on both horizons. SMI is up on both horizons.
